propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria as plain bullets instead of Acceptance Criteria checkboxes, making them invisible to AC item counting and attestation verification
A migration script must rewrite Success Criteria blocks to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes via rebar.edit_ticket, preserving auditability and handling both orderings (SC-before-AC and AC-before-SC)
The script must default to dry-run mode and require an explicit flag to modify non-closed tickets, preventing silent plan-review invalidation of in-flight claimed work
Post-migration verification must confirm zero Success Criteria headings remain, zero tickets fall below the AC floor, and all 106 migrated tickets are present in the store
Section-order sensitivity and parenthetical-qualified headings were defects caught during dry-run and post-run verification respectively, now pinned by held-out test cases
